display.purpose: Page and section headlines only — an engraved gazetteer register character, never body copy.

body.purpose: All prose. A civic-register sans built for government publishing systems.

label.purpose: Every ledger number, tag, nav item, and micro-label. Never a full sentence.

shadows.name: button-hover-paper
shadows.purpose: Default/ghost button hover on paper grounds.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover, reveal, and modal transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default ledger action button — ink fill, rectangular, lifts with a soft shadow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; padding: 14px 24px; border: 1.5px solid #1B1712; border-radius: 2px; background: #1B1712; color: #EFE6C9; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .01em; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(27,23,18,.22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8A2E22; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stamp Button
components.description: Registrar-red action button, reserved for the donate/submit call to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; padding: 14px 24px; border: 1.5px solid #8A2E22; border-radius: 2px; background: #8A2E22; color: #F4EEDA; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-btn-stamp:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(138,46,34,.35); }

components.name: Ledger Row (Card)
components.description: A register/site row: ruled bottom border, mono index number, category swatch tag, tabular data column.
components.css: .ds-site { width: 100%; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #B7A467; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 60px 1.6fr auto; gap: 20px; align-items: center; padding: 22px 10px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; transition: background .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-site:hover { background: #E6D9AE; transform: translateX(8px); } .ds-site-no { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: #6B5E3F; } .ds-site-name { font-family: 'Old Standard TT', serif; font-size: 20px; color: #1B1712; } .ds-site-tag { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4A4128; } .ds-site-data { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #4A4128; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Ledger Input Field
components.description: Form field with a mono uppercase label and hairline border that darkens on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4A4128; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #1B1712; background: #EFE6C9; border: 1px solid #6B5E3F; border-radius: 2px; padding: 13px 14px; transition: border-color .2s; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: #1B1712; border-width: 1.5px; outline: none; }

components.name: Register Navigation
components.description: Sticky register tab bar — mono uppercase links in ruled cells with a red underline on hover/active.
components.html: RegisterDonate
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 72px; background: #EFE6C9; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #1B1712; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4A4128; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; padding-inline: 16px; border-left: 1px solid #B7A467; position: relative; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: #8A2E22; transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform .25s; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page']::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.name: Registrar Seal
components.description: The signature stamp component — a rotated circular badge used sparingly for verified facts (hero, about, donate honesty notice).
components.css: .ds-seal { width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #8A2E22; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; transform: rotate(-7deg); color: #8A2E22; } .ds-seal::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6px; border: 1px solid #8A2E22; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-seal-text { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: The site is built to read as a forester's working-plan register, not a marketing page: hand-ruled ledger paper, india-ink linework, cross-hatched compartment maps, and rubber-stamped survey seals carry every claim the organisation makes. Nothing floats free of a rule, a box, or a ledger row — the design's authority comes from looking like a document a CSR auditor would already trust, not from persuasion copy. This directly rejects the generic plantation-NGO default (a leafy green gradient hero over a stock sapling photo, rounded pill buttons, emoji icons) in favor of flat ink-on-paper: rectangular controls, hairline rules, monospace ledger numerals, and a single registrar's-red stamp reserved for verified facts.
keyCharacteristics: Flat ink-on-paper — no gradients, no soft drop shadows, no rounded leaf iconography
Every category reads as a compartment on a cross-hatched survey map, never a colored icon tile
Rectangular, ruled controls throughout; radius is functionally zero
One accent reserved for meaning: registrar red appears only on verified facts and the primary donation action
Real photography desaturates toward sepia in list contexts and returns to full color on hover/focus

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Registrar red is spent on verified facts and the single primary donation action only. A screen with two red elements has diluted the seal's meaning.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: No gradients anywhere, including button and card backgrounds. Depth comes from rules, borders, and a soft ambient shadow on interaction only — never a color blend.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional or label text ever ships below 12px, even inside dense ledger chips — legibility outranks density in this system.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime only ever sets numbers, codes, or short uppercase labels. It never sets a sentence of prose.

rules.name: The Soft-Lift Rule
rules.body: Any hover shadow blurs and lifts; it never offsets with a hard, zero-blur edge.

dos: Do keep every category distinction legible through the cross-hatch pattern plus swatch, not color alone.
Do reserve registrar red for verified facts and the one primary donation action per screen.
Do set every number in tabular-nums so ledger columns align.
Do label illustrative or placeholder data honestly in the copy itself.
Do keep hover depth soft and blurred; keep structural depth in ink rules and borders.
donts: Don't add a kicker or eyebrow caption above any heading.
Don't use emoji as icons anywhere; every icon is an authored line-stroke SVG.
Don't round a button, input, or card corner beyond the 2px hairline radius.
Don't use a hard-offset, zero-blur box-shadow.
Don't invent a donation amount-to-impact conversion without real per-rupee cost data on file.
